item.description: Let’s talk about culture. Not the kind you find in a corporate slide deck. The kind that’s built over back-to-back harvests, family meals in the shop, and a quiet promise to do right by your neighbors.

item.title: Exploring the World of USA Rice with Michael Klein — Field Good Life
item.description: USA Rice is what we call a vertically integrated trade association. Translation: it brings together everybody with skin in the game—farmers, millers, merchants, exporters. That kind of collaboration isn’t easy, but it matters.

item.title: Tailgate Time: A New Approach to Farmer Support — Field Good Life
item.description: Farming will wring you out some days, and it’s not just the weather or the markets. It’s the pressure, the pride, the isolation, the unrelenting rhythm of seasons that don’t stop when your body or mind says it’s had enough.

item.title: Navigating the World of Crop Consulting with Sterling Clifton — Field Good Life
item.description: Agriculture doesn’t stand still. It never has. Sterling walked us through how farming has changed — from the way we manage crops to how we lean on data, research, and relationships more than ever.

item.title: The Power of Cooperatives in Agriculture — Field Good Life
item.description: Cooperatives don’t get talked about much unless something goes wrong. No one’s posting glamorous elevator photos on Instagram with a hashtag about agricultural economics. There’s no influencer campaign for the cooperative business model.

item.title: A Look Inside the Senate Ag Committee with Chairman John Boozman — Field Good Life
item.description: I had the chance to sit down with Senator Boozman the other day, and I’ll tell you what stuck with me wasn’t all the policy talk; it was how much they still need to hear from us.
